zh.title: 数字员工换班时，规程更新了，这笔账该怎么算？
zh.summary: 同一张工单、同一笔租金，规程一更新，300 元差额变成 0。12 次对照揭示了独立复算也会漏掉的版本错误。

en.title: The procedure changed between shifts. How should the next agent reconcile the account?
en.summary: One assignment, one rent payment, and two versions of the procedure. Twelve comparisons show how independent review can miss a change in the rule it applies.
